Thank you for your interest in the graduate programs offered by the School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences at Arizona State University.
Please review the program description for admission and degree requirements and for more details on how to apply.
If you have any questions regarding the degree program after reviewing the information above, please contact any of the faculty advisors:
Theoretical Math: Andrew Bremner John Jones John Quigg
Applied Math: Steven Baer Zdzislaw Jackiewicz Eric Kostelich
Mathematics Education: Marilyn Carlson Kyeong Hah Roh Pat Thompson
Statistics: Jarrett Barber May Boggess Mark Reiser
Sincerely,
Debbie Olson Graduate Program Coordinator ASU School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences grad.math@asu.edu
